title: WorkspaceFilesPayload
description: `workspace.files` payload (lazy tree; the no-argument form keeps the old depth≤2/≤300 behaviour, `2026-11-01-client-side-panels` R1).

depth.description: Depth relative to `path` (1..=2; absent keeps the legacy depth 2).

limit.description: Maximum entries (1..=500; absent keeps the legacy 300).
